Committee: Finance and Taxation Education
Sponsor: Livingston
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 03/07/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 244 as introduced exempts Nourish One Child from paying state, county and municipal sales and use taxes, which will decrease receipts to the following funds by the following estimated annual amounts:
Education Trust Fund
($260)
County Funds
($100)
Municipal Funds
($220)
Total
($580)
Arthur Orr, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation Education
